Based on the search results, the founder of CNN was Ted Turner. He was married three times:
1. Judy Nye (1960–1964) - First wife
2. Jane Shirley Smith (1965–1988) - Second wife
3. Jane Fonda (1991–2001) - Third wife

Therefore, the second wife of Ted Turner, the founder of CNN, was **Jane Shirley Smith**.
